services.title: Custom Software Development
services.description: I design and develop custom software solutions tailored to specific business requirements. From understanding complex workflows to implementing complete applications, I focus on building reliable, maintainable, and practical software that solves real-world problems.

services.title: Full-Stack Web Development
services.description: I build modern, end-to-end web applications using .NET and React. My work covers responsive user interfaces, backend services, database integration, authentication, and application architecture, delivering cohesive solutions from frontend to backend.

services.title: Backend & API Development
services.description: I develop robust backend systems and well-structured APIs that power modern applications. From implementing complex business logic and authentication to integrating third-party services, I prioritize performance, security, maintainability, and clean architecture.

services.title: Enterprise Software Solutions
services.description: I develop software for complex business operations, including enterprise management systems, ERP solutions, banking applications, educational platforms, and client-management systems. I enjoy turning intricate business requirements and workflows into efficient, integrated software solutions.

services.title: Database Design & Integration
services.description: I design and implement structured database solutions that support reliable and scalable applications. From data modelling and query optimization to database integration and managing complex relationships, I focus on data integrity, efficiency, and long-term maintainability.

services.title: Software Architecture & Consulting
services.description: I help transform software ideas and business requirements into practical technical solutions. Whether selecting an appropriate technology stack, designing application architecture, evaluating existing systems, or planning for scalability, I provide engineering-oriented guidance grounded in real development experience.

services.title: Code Review & Optimization
services.description: I review existing codebases to identify architectural weaknesses, performance bottlenecks, maintainability issues, and opportunities for improvement. My goal is to help teams build cleaner, more efficient, reliable, and sustainable software.

services.title: Technical Mentoring & Knowledge Sharing
services.description: I enjoy helping aspiring developers navigate the world of software development. Through technical guidance, problem-solving discussions, and sharing practical development knowledge, I help beginners strengthen their fundamentals and become more confident engineers. I also welcome opportunities to learn together.
